title: Database Systems Fundamentals
description: This course is designed for beginners who want to learn the basics of database systems, including data storage, retrieval, and management. Students will learn how to design, implement, and query databases using relational databases and SQL.

modules.title: Introduction to Databases
modules.summary: Learn the basics of databases, including what a database is, how it's different from paper-based storage, and the role of database management systems.

modules.title: Setting Up a Database
modules.summary: Install and configure MySQL on Windows and macOS, and learn how to create a first database.

modules.title: Working with Tables
modules.summary: Learn how to create, modify, and delete tables in a database, including using data types and primary keys.

modules.title: Querying and Joining Data
modules.summary: Master the basics of SQL queries, including inserting data, joining tables, and using subqueries.

modules.title: Database Design
modules.summary: Learn how to design a database schema using entity-relationship diagrams, including entities, attributes, and relationships.
